technology_name: Vacuum-Based Self-Holding Drilling Machine with Automatic Detection and Control System
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Automated Drilling Rig / Smart Actuator System
problem_solved: Manual heavy structural drilling on non-horizontal surfaces risks operator injury, drill bit slippage, and structural damage from uneven force vectors.
description: An automated, self-holding drilling machine integration utilizing active vacuum suction pad arrays to clamp securely onto smooth or non-planar walls, governed by an onboard microcontroller network that checks real-time drilling depth and feed pressures.
applications: High-rise construction window mounting, maritime metal hull repair assemblies, aerospace structural rivet drill fields, and automated large-bore pipeline installation.
